Kyzrati is one of my favorite roguelike developers. He makes such great and interesting things and in my opinion is one of the few developers really pushing the genre further. He might help make the genre evolve altogether. I don't normally give that kind of praise, but his ASCII effects and UI work along with his other projects like REXPaint and the things he creates with them are amazing.

I don't think it's a stagnant genre, but you generally know everything to expect when you play a roguelike. The fun comes in the implementation of those features. Kyzrati is changing that in my opinion. Many roguelikes are indistinguishable from one another at first glance (at least to those who aren't overly familiar with the genre and even then) however his games stand out. Both due to game design and technical improvements. I think as his ideas and tools (REXPaint is free for any use!) are further proliferated throughout the roguelike community we'll have a bit of a renaissance and the genre with be pushed forward. Not that he'll do it single-handedly. With the popularity of roguelites in recent years along with other new roguelikes trying different things, I think it'll all culminate into something fun that will suck away many hours of our free time.
